thesis: Kaliv is one personal AI across Windows, Android, KalivHub and Quest; ModelRig is the local-first, model-agnostic infrastructure that keeps identity, memory, perception and action under explicit control.
release_status: Not yet qualified for V1; {{ stats.public_open_en | lower }}
known_boundaries: Original voice continuity PR #2205 was closed without merge on 2026-10-16. This historical PR does not establish voice continuity in the latest release.

KalivHub has a manual physical Cast proof and historical Home Assistant/room-first CI evidence. Signed Android mirroring PR #{{ android_mirror.number }} is parked and was closed without merge on {{ android_mirror.closed }}; physical product acceptance is not established by these records.
Nest Hub microphone input remains unverified after the isolated probe returned NotFoundError.
Cross-surface continuity, restart behavior, latency and extended soak testing remain unqualified for V1.
